subject: english
prompt: 提示：Lina / practice the violin / every Friday. Choose the sentence that keeps the habitual time clue and correct verb form.

options.text: Lina practices the violin every Friday.
Lina practice the violin every Friday.
Every Friday practices Lina the violin.
Lina is practice the violin every Friday.

answer.explanation: Every Friday marks a repeated habit, so use the simple present. Lina is one person, so practice takes -s; the object follows the verb and the time phrase can close the sentence.

solutionStrategy: 把頻率／時間線索和主詞一起判斷：先定現在習慣，再檢查第三人稱單數動詞，最後核對受詞位置。
solutionSteps: 從提示中找時間線索 every Friday，判斷這是規律習慣。
確認主詞 Lina 是第三人稱單數。
把 practice 改為 practices，因為現在簡單式單數主詞要加 -s。
按主詞＋動詞＋受詞＋時間的順序組句。
選 A；B 少了動詞字尾，C 詞序錯，D 的 is 後不能直接接原形 practice。
